title: Verification and validation: are we building it right, are we building the right thing

videos.script: A program can do exactly what its requirements say and still be the wrong program. {{wrong}} Testing asks two questions here, and they have names. {{names}} Verification asks whether boxoffice matches what was written down. Are we building it right? {{verify}} Validation asks whether what was written down is what the theatre needs. Are we building the right thing? {{validate}} The first is answered against R1 to R9, and anybody holding them can answer it. The second needs the people who have the need. {{people}} Some of the cheapest testing in this course runs nothing at all. You read the requirements, and you find a sentence two people would read two ways. {{review}} Then you book for a family and for a school, and every check passes. {{journeys}} And you decide where each finding goes, when the problem is the requirement itself. {{where}}
